# commentary/

## Purpose
Generated commentary on a report pack, held as a DRAFT until a named person approves it. Table `report_commentary`, migrations 611 and 612.

## Caller contract
Called by `pages/api/accounting/commentary/*` under `withAuth`; company always from the session. Consumed on the public side by `share/sharedPackService.ts`, which selects `approved_text` and filters `status = 'approved'`. Every statement here carries `company_id`, including the UPDATEs.

## Main signatures
- `listCommentary(companyId, params) → CommentaryRow[]` — the whole pack, unfiltered. There is no section parameter on the route or the hook; `CommentaryBlock` owns the per-section filter.
- `generateDrafts({ companyId, userId, params, data, replace? }) → { written, skipped }`.
- `approveCommentary(companyId, id, userId, editedText?)` (in `commentaryApprove.ts`, re-exported from the service) / `rejectCommentary(...)` → `CommentaryResult`, failing with `not_found` (404), `empty_draft` (400), `invalid_text` (400), `text_too_long` (400), `commentary_budget_exceeded` (400) or `invalid_state` (409) — the route must not collapse them. `editedText` absent copies `draft_text`; present writes the trimmed text and leaves `draft_text` the machine draft.
- `commentaryCost(texts)`, `MAX_APPROVED_PACK_EMS`, `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS`, `approxCharsLeft`, `normaliseEditedText`, `editedTextProblem` (`commentaryLimits.ts`, client-safe) — the ONE cost function the service, the editor and the tests share. `commentaryApprove.ts` holds `approveCommentary`; `commentaryBudget.ts` the server half (which packs are budgeted, the per-pack lock and pack read); `commentaryRow.ts` the row/result types and the two reads.
- `nextStatus(current, action) → Transition`; `buildDraftSentences(data) → DraftSentence[]`; `buildManagementPackData(companyId, params)`.
- `approveCommentary(..., editedText?, reportKind = 'pack', expectedDraft?)` / `rejectCommentary(..., reportKind = 'pack', expectedDraft?)`: a row of another `report_kind` answers `not_found`. `expectedDraft` (the draft the approver was shown; the variance service always passes it) makes a re-drafted row `invalid_state` and is repeated in the UPDATE on both the plain and the edited path: nobody approves text they never saw. The pack routes never pass a kind, so they cannot reach a variance note.
- Budget variance notes (budgets P5 §3e): `varianceCommentary.ts` `listVarianceNotes(companyId, role, versionId, month)`, `saveVarianceNote(companyId, {userId, role}, {versionId, month, glAccountId, cc1Id, cc2Id, buId, text})`, `approveVarianceNote(companyId, actor, id, seenDraft, editedText?)`, `rejectVarianceNote(companyId, actor, id, seenDraft)` → `{ok, note}` or a failure code (`forbidden` 403, `not_found` 404, `bad_request`/`empty_draft`/`invalid_text`/`text_too_long` 400, `invalid_state` 409); `listApprovedVarianceNotes(companyId, versionId, months)` (the management pack). `varianceNoteScope.ts` checks every id is the company's; `varianceNoteTypes.ts` (import-free, client-safe) holds the row key and the role rules.

## Business rules
- **Status machine** (`commentaryState.ts` is the only place a status changes): `draft → approved` (approve), `draft → rejected` (reject), `* → draft` (generate). `generate` on an approved row FAILS.
- **The `replace` gate.** `replace: true` is the only path that re-drafts a row a person already ruled on: it withdraws an approval and revives a rejection. Without it both are left alone and reported in `skipped` — a discarded sentence does not come back because somebody pressed Generate again. The route restricts `replace` to owner/admin; `CommentaryPanel` puts an explicit, single-use confirmation in front of it.
- A withdrawal is STAMPED, not erased: `withdrawn_by`/`withdrawn_at` are set and `approved_text`/`approved_by`/`approved_at` survive, so the row still says who signed off. Nothing leaks — the published query filters on status.
- The `ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... WHERE` repeats the decision at the write, on the row's state at write time, because another session can approve or reject inside the read-to-write window.
- An empty or whitespace-only draft is never approvable. The 611 CHECK would store the blank.
- Approval writes status, text, approver and timestamp in ONE statement so the CHECK never sees a half-approved row; the WHERE repeats the guard so two racing approvals cannot both write.
- The draft builder never writes `approved_text`. Nothing generated reaches a share link without a person.

- **Variance notes** (`report_kind = 'budget_variance'`): `params_hash = sha256('bva|'||version_id||'|'||'YYYY-MM')` (`reports/varianceParamsHash.ts`, server-only), `period_start/end` the month's bounds, `section_ref = 'account'`, `row_ref = gl_account_id|cc1|cc2|bu` ('' for none, ids lower-cased). Save refuses Login-as first (`assertNotImpersonating`, as approve/reject); approve/reject UPDATEs repeat `report_kind`. Human text → `draft_text`, `generated_by = 'human:<uid>'`, checked by `editedTextProblem` and `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS`. Writers owner/admin/manager (`mayWriteVarianceNote(role, slice)`: the hook for P5-6's budget holders, who write their own slice only); approve/reject owner/admin. An approved note is re-drafted by an approver only (approval stamped withdrawn), a manager gets 409; a rejected one is revived by a save. Drafts are listed to `canReadSharingSurface` roles only. Version, month (inside the version's year), account (revenue/expense) and dims (`resolveTrackingFilter`) are the company's or `not_found`.
- **Reader census (`report_kind`)**: `listCommentary`, `generateDrafts`, `packDraftState` (page 4), `sharedPackService.loadApprovedCommentary` and the list route read `'pack'` only; `approveCommentary`/`rejectCommentary` serve the caller's kind; `lockAndReadPack` reads the row's own kind and is reached only for a pack row (`printsOnFixedPage` is false for any other kind); the variance service reads `'budget_variance'` only. Proved by `budgets-p5-variance-{notes,pack,routes}.int.test.ts` (share link and page 4 drop a variance row even under the pack's own hash).

## Recent changes
- 2026-11-03 (budgets P5-5): variance notes on `report_commentary` (no migration); `printsOnFixedPage` false for `report_kind <> 'pack'` (a variance approval takes no page-4 budget and no pack lock); approve/reject take the caller's kind, so the pack routes 404 a variance row (census T1.3: they would have let a manager reject one).
- 2026-10-07: approve-with-edits.
  - **Rules.** `POST .../[id]/approve` takes an optional `{ text: string }`. The body must be absent/empty or a plain object (a string or array is a 400, never read as "no text"); `text` must be a string, never coerced. An edit writes the trimmed text and leaves `draft_text` the machine draft. CRLF and lone CR become LF before validating and storing. `empty_draft`: no visible character (whitespace, `\p{Cf}`, any `\p{M}` combining mark, Hangul fillers, the braille blank). `invalid_text`: NUL, C0 and C1 controls (except `\n`, `\t`), lone surrogates. `text_too_long`: an edited row on a pack with no fixed page, over `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS = 4000`. A PLAIN approval is a compare-and-set on the draft it costed (`AND draft_text = <read>`); a regenerate in between gives `invalid_state` "draft text changed, reload".
  - **Budget.** Board pack only. Page 4 joins every approved row (trimmed, one space, `section_ref, row_ref` order) into one paragraph, and an overflowing page REFUSES the whole pack (`PackRefusal`). `commentaryCost` fills that joined paragraph with page 4's own fill (`packProseFill`) at an UPPER BOUND on its widths (`packProseBound.proseLinesBound`: each code point the faces set at its advance plus the most any kerning pair adds, from the generated `packProseAdvanceData`; a cluster the faces lack from the regular label style's fallback table, read from the gate's own generated copy `packProseFallbackData` by `packFallbackWidthCore`, so the editor loads one style's table and not four; client-safe, no fontkit), refused over `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS` (`text_too_long`) before it is costed, so the cost model never reads unbounded tenant text, and filled by page 4's own fill, Chromium's breaks and each piece whole (so a token wider than the line costs what it prints: two hyphenated 40-letter runs cost 784.7, past the cap; #1263 round 1), at both prose measures (stacked, and two thirds beside the panel) as lines x line-ems, the worse of the two: the gate never reads fewer lines than the page (Hein, 11-10, option ii; `packProseAdvances.test.ts` regenerates and holds the table, REGENERATE_PROSE_ADVANCES=1; `printParity/packProseLinesImage.test.ts` holds it to production). `MAX_APPROVED_PACK_EMS = 760`: the tightest fixture (`liveDemoShortPanelsInput`) holds 787 on caps, digits, wide glyphs, long words and words of 10/26 (prose 813, url 838, CJK 939; other fixtures 1083-1996), ~1450 characters of prose. The whole joined text is costed, not each row, because per-row line ceilings charge every row its half-empty last line (up to ~100 ems over seven rows). Pinned by `packApprovedCommentaryCap.test.ts`: at budget fits 4 fixtures x all kinds (uniform sweep 10..70, alternating cases, 40 seeded mixed texts, rows cut at spaces); 3.5x refuses on all; 1.3x on the tightest. Re-calibrate if page 4's geometry, `PROSE.narrativeBody` or the faces move.
  - **Which pages.** Board = page 4 "Commentary and actions", fixed sheet, budgeted and serialised per pack by `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('<company>:<kind>:<hash>', 611))` taken BEFORE the pack is read, inside the `withAuth` transaction (the service throws without one); proved on real Postgres by `tests/integration/commentary-budget-race.int.test.ts` (sized from the current budget). Management and monthly never feed approved text to a page model, so they take no budget and no lock; the pack type is recovered by matching `params_hash` against `canonicalParamsHash({type, period_start, period_end})` with the dates read as `to_char(.., 'YYYY-MM-DD')` (proved under non-ISO DateStyle by `tests/integration/commentary-datestyle.int.test.ts`); a row matching no type is budgeted (fail closed). Both integration tests need the disposable fixture DB.
  - **UI.** `CommentaryEditor`: focused textarea prefilled with the draft, `role=status` "about N characters left" from `commentaryCost` with the row substituted at its place, Approve disabled over budget (server is the authority), focus returns to the row on cancel/success, Edit button named by the sentence the row shows (whitespace collapsed, 60 chars). Page 4's prose and derived panel have `overflow-wrap: anywhere` (`styles/packPrintTablesAndProse.css`; `anywhere` not `break-word`, because only it lowers min-content so the `2fr 1fr` grid stops growing; proved in Chromium by `tests/unit/print/packNarrativeLongToken.test.ts`); the share-link `<p>` has `break-words`. `fitBodyPage` (`packs/pages/packNarrativeFit.ts`) words the refusal when approved commentary overflows, naming the sheet from its position.
- 2026-09-26 (R-032 L5): `approveCommentary`, `rejectCommentary` now call `assertNotImpersonating()` (`src/lib/auth/impersonationGuard.ts`) as their FIRST statement: a platform-admin "Login as" session gets `ImpersonationForbiddenError` → 403 `IMPERSONATION_FORBIDDEN` before anything is read or written. Bearer callers (MCP, PATs) and jobs carry no `session_id` and pass. The guard runs one `sql` query, so a unit test that mocks `sql` with a positional queue must also mock the guard (`vi.mock('@/lib/auth/impersonationGuard', ...)` with `assertNotImpersonating: async () => undefined`) or every later query shifts by one.
- 2026-09-06: the list route's GET arm is owner/admin/manager (`canReadSharingSurface`). It returns DRAFT text, and `withWriteAccess` lets every read method through.
- 2026-09-06: migration 612 adds `withdrawn_by` / `withdrawn_at`; the replace path stamps them and leaves the approval columns intact.
